purpose: Quantify twilight sky-radiance and Level-B naked-eye threshold sensitivity to physically coherent wavelength-dependent OPAC aerosol mixtures and to the spherical-versus-spheroidal desert phase-function treatment, at fixed AOD550 and the frozen AFC2/AOPS geometry/numerical surface.

parentEvidence.aopsFindingBoundary: AOD550 alone is insufficient; constant SSA/g controls are useful sensitivity levers but are not a wavelength-dependent realistic aerosol model and g is not the full angular phase function.

scientificQuestion.primary: At the same AOD550, geometry, atmosphere and Monte-Carlo design used by AOPS, how strongly do physically coherent OPAC aerosol mixtures with wavelength-dependent optical properties and angular scattering functions change modeled twilight sky radiance and Level-B limiting magnitude?
scientificQuestion.shape: For the OPAC desert mixture, how strongly does replacing spherical mineral-particle scattering with the preregistered spheroidal treatment change the same endpoints when the mixture family and AOD550 are otherwise paired?
scientificQuestion.interpretationBoundary: This is a controlled model sensitivity challenge over selected physically coherent OPAC mixtures. It is not a frequency-weighted aerosol climatology, a fitted site aerosol retrieval, or a production correction.

runtimeAndOpticalPropertyBinding.phaseFunctionInterpretation: The OPAC netCDF optical-property files include angular scattering information/full phase-matrix data. The present experiment keeps the existing scalar twilight-radiance endpoint and does not add a polarization observable; it tests the richer angular scattering function consumed by the existing scalar MYSTIC configuration.

aerosolStates.description: AOPS/R8 rural spring-summer Shettle bridge state; no OPAC species_file.
OPAC continental-average mixture, retained as the within-OPAC continental reference.
OPAC clean-maritime mixture, providing a coarse sea-salt-rich regime contrast.
OPAC desert mixture with spherical mineral-particle optical properties.
OPAC desert variation using spheroidal mineral-particle optical properties; paired directly against opac-desert as the shape/angular-scattering contrast.

stateSelectionRationale.minimalFiveStateRule: Keep the same five-state/360-case cardinality as AOPS while spanning the prior native bridge, a continental OPAC reference, a maritime coarse-particle regime, a mineral-dust regime, and a direct spherical-versus-spheroidal dust comparison.
stateSelectionRationale.urbanOmitted: Urban is not included in v1 because AOPS already isolated strong absorption/SSA sensitivity and AFC2 R8 already included an urban Shettle family. The fresh question here is richer coherent spectral/angular scattering and the nonspherical-dust shape effect, not another broad absorption endpoint.
stateSelectionRationale.allTenMixturesNotRun: The ten-mixture syntax audit was a runtime capability gate, not a scientific case-selection rule. Running all ten would add redundant mixture variants without improving the targeted phase-function question enough to justify the extra scientific universe.

contrastDefinition.scalarAndSpectral: For every cell and replicate, natural-log ratio ln(Y_alternative/Y_reference). Spectral contrasts are nodewise on the frozen 380-780 nm raw grid.
contrastDefinition.dustShapeContrastPriority: desert_spheroids_vs_desert is the direct preregistered particle-shape/angular-scattering contrast and must be reported independently of all mixture-versus-native summaries.
contrastDefinition.replicateSummary: Retain all three paired replicate values; report arithmetic mean, sample SD with n-1 denominator, and SE=SD/sqrt(3).

secondaryLevelBEndpoint.pairedDeltaDefinition: alternative limiting V magnitude minus reference limiting V magnitude for the same seven preregistered contrasts
